title: Lead Generation for High-class Web Designer
desc:
I craft modern, conversion-focused websites and now want a steady stream of new projects. Your role is simple: connect me with small-business owners who are actively seeking a brand-new site and I will pay you US $20 for every client that signs and pays the initial deposit.

Target market
My sweet spot is the small-business segment—retail shops, health & wellness practices, tech start-ups—and I’ve also had success with real-estate agents, interior designers, plumbers, carpenters and professional photographers. Geography is wide open, with current emphasis on North America, Canada, Europe and Asia, so you can prospect wherever your network is strongest.

What I need from you
• Warm introductions or directly closed deals for a full website build.
• A brief written overview of each lead’s needs (industry, size, desired features, budget range).
• Confirmation that the lead knows my pricing starts at standard market rates and is ready to move forward.

How you get paid
The moment a referred client pays the kickoff invoice, I release your US $20 commission—no waiting for project completion. Bring in multiple clients and you’ll earn multiple payouts; there’s no cap.

If you already have contacts who fit this profile or you’re confident in your outreach ability, let’s start immediately.

title: Captivating Product Prototype 3D Models
desc:
I need detailed, photorealistic 3D models created in AutoCAD for several product prototypes that my private-limited company will unveil in our upcoming marketing campaigns. The CAD geometry must accurately follow the dimensional sketches I provide while also lending itself to polished still renders suitable for brochures, pitch decks, and web banners.

Because these models are solely for marketing presentation, visual appeal is paramount: clean topology, precise surface transitions, and materials that look believable under studio lighting. Once each model is approved, I’ll also need two to three high-resolution rendered views (PNG or JPEG) that showcase the product in a neutral environment.

Deliverables
• Native AutoCAD (.dwg) file for each prototype  
• Exported universal formats (.STEP or .IGES) for potential cross-platform edits  
• 2–3 high-resolution marketing renders per model  

I can share reference sketches, basic dimensions, and brand style guidelines as soon as we start. Let me know your typical turnaround time per prototype and any similar portfolio pieces so I can gauge fit and schedule the first milestone right away.

title: Local Web Client Acquisition Partner
desc:
I create conversion-focused websites for local small businesses and I’m ready to ramp up fast. What I need now is a driven partner who can spot opportunities on Google Maps and turn cold emails into warm, interested owners.

Target market  
Restaurants, cafés and brick-and-mortar retail stores in our area that have no site or a painfully dated one.

Your mission  
Hunt for those prospects, start the conversation, and hand them off once they’re ready to hear a proposal. I’ll handle every step after that—strategy, design, build and delivery.

Earnings  
For every website project that closes we split the revenue 70/30. No ceiling: the more clients you bring in, the more you take home.

Deliverables  
• Spreadsheet of qualified leads with email, phone and current site status  
• Personalized outreach messages sent and tracked  
• Warm introductions or booked calls for me to close

If turning Google Maps searches into real website deals is second nature to you, let’s launch the first campaign this week.

title: Refine My Existing Design
desc:
I already have the core design in place, but several details still feel off and need a professional eye. Your role is to review the current file, spot inconsistencies, and apply precise tweaks so everything looks polished and cohesive.  

I will share the source assets (layered PSD/AI plus export previews) along with a short list of the issues I have noticed; you are welcome to flag anything else that compromises visual balance or brand consistency. Please return the updated editable file and a set of web-ready exports once the corrections are complete.  

If you have a quick question about my brand guidelines or need additional references, just ask—I am available for fast feedback so we can wrap this up efficiently.

title: KET/PET Curriculum Developer for AI Platform
desc:

Position: Cambridge KET & PET Curriculum Developer
Type: Freelance / Project-based
Target learners: Young English learners, approximately 8–12+
Platform: AI-powered English learning platform

About SeekLight

SeekLight is an AI-powered English learning platform designed to help children develop practical English through structured learning, speaking practice, real-world situations, assessment, and personalized feedback.

Our vision is to move beyond traditional lesson-based learning. Students should learn English through missions, not simply through lessons.

Instead of completing a traditional sequence of textbook lessons, students enter different real-world missions where they need to use English to complete tasks, communicate, solve problems, and demonstrate what they have learned.

Examples could include:

*  Airport Mission
*  Restaurant Mission
*  Hotel Mission
*  Shopping Mission
*  School Mission
*  Café Mission
*  Travel Mission
*  Doctor / Health Mission
*  Planning an Event Mission

The missions will still follow a carefully structured curriculum and progression toward Cambridge KET (A2 Key) and PET (B1 Preliminary) objectives.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced English curriculum developer / Cambridge exam specialist to help us design the pedagogical foundation for SeekLight’s KET and PET programs.

The objective is not to create hundreds of traditional lessons.

Instead, you will help us develop the curriculum framework, learn

title: Realistic NSFW Image-to-Video Workflow
desc: I’m looking for an AI video specialist to create a realistic NSFW image-to-video workflow. I need strong facial/identity preservation and support for adult scenarios. It must be cloud-based since I don’t have a powerful PC, and it should be completely plug-and-play: I simply upload/replace the image, enter my prompt, and generate the video. I’m open to any platform/model that delivers the best quality.

title: Manual Enhancement of Two Voices
desc:
I have a two-minute casual conversation captured on a single track with three speakers. Speaker A sits well in the mix, but the passages from Speaker B and Speaker C are buried. I need both their volume and clarity brought up to match Speaker A, while keeping the tone natural and free of artifacts.  

Please run a gentle broadband noise reduction across the entire recording to tame the room hiss, yet preserve the ambience so it still feels authentic. Because this is a sensitive personal matter, avoid any AI-based speech reconstruction or voice cloning; rely solely on traditional audio-engineering techniques such as EQ, multiband compression, spectral repair, and manual gain riding.  

Deliverables  
• One cleaned stereo WAV (or AIFF) at the original sample rate/bit depth  
• A concise note describing the processing chain and key settings applied  

Keep every other element untouched, and return the finished file within 48 hours. Confidentiality is essential—delete any working copies once the project is handed over.

title: Aurora Smart Short Drama
desc:
I run a short-drama studio and want to turn our existing footage into high-performing 9:16 TikTok reels. I’ll provide all raw video files plus any branding assets; you transform them into scroll-stopping clips with a clear narrative hook and subtle, ambient sound design.

Key focus  
• Sound and music integration is the main creative lever. Every clip should carry an ambient, understated track or effect that heightens emotion without overpowering dialogue.  
• Strong opening three seconds to hook viewers and drive watch-through.  
• Finished aspect ratio: 1080×1920, ready for TikTok upload.  
• Revenue-share model: no upfront fee—your commission is tied directly to the conversions your edits generate. I track each clip’s performance so payouts remain transparent.

There’s no hard deadline; consistency is more important than speed. If you already cut short-form drama, send a link to your portfolio and note any past TikTok successes. Looking forward to building a long-term partnership where great storytelling meets shared upside.

title: Azure Cloud Operations Mentoring
desc:
FYI: I am total beginner 

I am making the leap from a Major Incident Manager role into hands-on Azure Cloud Operations and I’m looking for a seasoned mentor to guide me through the transition. My ideal partner has at least five years of real-world Azure experience in a Cloud Ops or SRE setting and has already helped other ITSM professionals pivot successfully.

Please share Linkedin profile as well.

Scope of guidance
• Weekly one-on-one Zoom or Teams sessions (camera-on, live lab sharing).
• Structured path toward passing AZ-900 and especially AZ-104, with emphasis on production-grade administration skills.
• Deep dives on the operational stack: VMs, Networking (VNets, NSGs, VPN, Load Balancer), Storage, Microsoft Entra ID, Monitoring & Log Analytics, plus PowerShell, Azure CLI and Linux basics for automation.
• Practical troubleshooting playbooks for common incident patterns in Azure, including war-room simulations.
• Best-practice runbooks for cloud operations and continuous improvement culture.
• Career collateral: iterative résumé rewrites and mock interviews tailored to Cloud Engineer / SRE openings.

Deliverables
1. A customised study plan, updated after each session.
2. Hands-on labs or demos I can repeat independently (Terraform/Bicep optional but welcome).
3. Two full mock exams for AZ-104 with debrief.
4. A polished cloud-focused résumé plus at least two recorded mock interview sessions with feedback.

Success for me means passing AZ-104, articulating cloud-incide

title: Hindi Novel Translation & Typing
desc:
A complete Hindi novel currently exists only in hard-copy form. The project involves two intertwined tasks. First, every word of the printed text must be retyped with absolute accuracy, keeping chapter breaks, dialogues, and any stylistic emphasis exactly as on the page so I can work with an editable manuscript. Immediately after, that freshly typed Hindi file needs to be rendered into smooth, idiomatic prose in the target language—English is my initial preference, though I’m open to discussing another language if it better suits your expertise.

Faithfulness to the author’s tone, cultural nuance, and emotional flow is crucial; the translation should read like an original novel, not a literal word-for-word copy. A solid grasp of literary Hindi, contemporary vocabulary, and narrative pacing will make the difference here.

Deliverables:
• Clean, proof-read Word document of the full Hindi text  
• Parallel Word document containing the complete translation, formatted to mirror the original (chapter titles, paragraph breaks, footnotes if present)

Please outline a realistic timeline for both typing and translation, along with any preferred tools (e.g., MS Word, Google Docs, CAT software) so I can coordinate review milestones. Completion of a brief sample page may be requested before we finalize the schedule.

title: Detailed Revit BIM Development
desc:
I have a set of PDF / CAD drawings that must be converted into a fully developed Revit BIM model. The scope goes well beyond a simple massing study: I need floor plans, sections and elevations, and full construction/working drawings produced at an advanced level of detail suitable for detailed construction documents.

Please start from the supplied files and build an organised, clean-layered Revit file that follows standard architectural naming and view templates. All sheets, schedules and annotations should read clearly so the model is ready for direct issue to consultants and contractors. Speed is important—I would like to move on this ASAP, so let me know your expected turnaround once you have reviewed the drawings.

Deliverables:
• Revit (.rvt) model with LOD suitable for detailed construction documents  
• Complete sheet set: floor plans, sections, elevations, and construction/working drawings formatted for print  
• Schedules generated directly from the model (doors, windows, finishes, etc.)  

I will supply reference PDFs/CAD, title block, and any project standards you require immediately after award.

title: Wedding Day Coordination & Staffing -- 2
desc:
I’m looking for an experienced day-of coordinator who can step in on our wedding day and keep every moving part on schedule for roughly 50–150 guests. I’ll hand over all the planning details in advance; on the day itself I need you to take the reins so my partner and I can focus on celebrating.  

Your core responsibilities will be:  
• Vendor coordination – become the point of contact for all suppliers, confirm arrival times, oversee setup, and handle any last-minute issues.  
• Guest management – greet and direct friends and family, troubleshoot seating or transport questions, and keep everyone informed of what’s happening next.  
• Timeline execution – run the master schedule, cue the processional, speeches, cake cutting, and make sure we stay on track from first look to final send-off.  

Before the event, I’d like a brief consultation to walk through our timeline, floor plan, and vendor list, plus a quick site visit if your schedule allows. On the day, please arrive early enough to supervise setup and remain until all formalities are complete.  

If you also provide servers, bartenders, or a setup/teardown crew, let me know—those services aren’t locked in yet and I’m open to adding them through you for a seamless experience.  

When you reply, share a note on similar weddings you’ve run, your available team size, and any tools or apps you use to keep everything organized (HoneyBook, Aisle Planner, Google Sheets, etc.). Looking forward to handing the clipboard to a pro wh

title: Neha barman
desc:
I have a collection of PDF and Word files that must be converted into clean, fully editable Google Docs while preserving every element of their complex layout—headings, paragraphs, graphs, charts, and any embedded objects. Your role is to replicate the original look and feel so that the finished documents are virtually indistinguishable from the source files, yet easy for my team to update inside Google Workspace.

Accuracy is critical: figures in charts must match the source exactly, all captions and labels need to stay aligned, and the final Google Docs should be free of stray formatting tags or spacing issues. If you normally rely on advanced Google Docs features (linked charts, drawing tools, add-ons, etc.), feel free to use them as long as the document remains 100 % editable without extra plugins on my side.

Deliverables:
• One Google Docs file per original document, formatted to mirror the source  
• Embedded graphs and charts recreated with native Google tools  
• A brief changelog noting any elements that could not be reproduced exactly and how you adjusted them

I will share the first batch the moment we agree on the timeline. Let me know your estimated turnaround for 10 documents and any relevant samples of similar conversion work you have completed.

title: Two-Storey Mixed-Use Building Plan
desc:
I’m looking for a professional who can turn my rough concept into clear, construction-ready drawings for a 32 ft × 45 ft plot. The ground floor will carry four shutter-front retail shops, a shared washroom, and a sizable godown. Above that, I need a self-contained studio apartment that includes a bathroom, kitchen, and six separate compartments to be used as offices. 

The overall look should balance modern practicality with traditional touches, as I prefer a mixed architectural style. We will build primarily in brick and concrete, so the plans must reflect realistic wall thicknesses, column placement, and service runs suited to that material palette. I also need the main stair, a clearly marked lift shaft, and thoughtfully positioned entrances that allow for upward expansion in the future.

before drawing , We’ll refine the finer points together in a short Google Meet session.

title: Analisi statistica tesi ginecologia
Heavy-Duty Precision Rail System
desc:
I'm looking for an experienced fabricator to design a 3' x 8' rail system anchored into a cement floor, specifically designed for a Fanuc 200iB/210F robot. This system will be used in a manufacturing environment and must support a significant weight with high precision.

Key Requirements:
- Must support approximately 3,000lbs using two roller type linear guideway bearings.
- High precision is critical.
- Anchored securely into a cement floor so the rails are even with the surrounding floor level.
- Accommodate a fork lift drive over on occasion when making large tool changes.
- Indoor installation only.

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Experience in heavy-duty rail system fabrication.
- Proficiency with linear guideway bearings.
- Strong understanding of precision engineering and weight capacity requirements.
- Ability to work with and anchor systems into cement.

Additional Information:
A PDF of the expected rails and guides will be provided for reference. Please provide examples of similar work and ensure you have the necessary skills for precision and weight handling. Looking forward to your bids!

title: Hindi Book Retyping Project
desc:
I have a complete Hindi book scanned to PDF—mostly text with occasional tables—and I need every page retyped into a clean, editable Word document. You may work directly in Microsoft Word; no other tool is necessary.

Please keep the original layout intact: headings, paragraph breaks, page order, and any tables that appear. Basic accuracy is fine, so minor typos that slip through normal proofreading won’t be a deal-breaker, but I do expect sensible spell-checking and consistent Unicode Hindi typing throughout.

Deliverable  
• One formatted .docx file mirroring the scanned pages, ready for further editing or print.

When you reply, let me know:  
• Your fixed price for the whole book  
• How quickly you can finish once I supply the files  
• A brief note on similar Hindi typing work you’ve completed

If this first book goes smoothly, I have several more waiting.

title: Structural Engineer with PE Stamp for NC Steel Frame
desc:
I have already run the full structural calculations for a light-steel frame that will carry a single-steel frame in North Carolina. what I need now is a formal peer review and professional stamp from a NC PE so the package glides through local plan check.

Your review should focus primarily on the load assumptions, with particular attention to wind loading. Please verify that everything aligns with IBC 2021 for wind and standard engineering practice. If you spot anything that warrants adjustment, concise red-line comments in the PDF are all I need—I will revise and return the final copy for your signature.

Deliverable  
• One PDF containing the verified, signed, and digitally (or wet) stamped calculation set, ready to submit for permit approval.  

Turnaround speed is important, but accuracy is paramount. Let me know your typical review window and any documentation you require up front so we can keep this moving.

title: Digitize Handwritten Manuscript into PDF
desc:
I have between 50 and 100 pages of handwritten material that needs to become a clean, searchable PDF. No fancy layout is necessary—plain text only, laid out so the flow of the original pages is easy to follow.

You will receive high-resolution scans as soon as we start. The writing is generally clear, but there are occasional margin notes and strike-throughs that must be captured exactly as written. Accuracy matters more than speed; spelling, punctuation, and line breaks should match the source.

Deliverables
• One PDF containing the fully typed text, page-for-page with the manuscript.  
• (Optional, but helpful) a simple .txt or .docx copy for future edits.

Acceptance criteria
• Every page transcribed with an error rate below 1 % on a random check.  
• PDF opens flawlessly in Adobe Acrobat and is fully searchable.

Let me know your estimated turnaround time and which tools—OCR, manual typing, Adobe Acrobat, etc.—you prefer to use. I will provide a brief NDA before sharing the scans to keep the content confidential.

title: Modern Home Interior Design
desc:
My newly purchased residence needs a cohesive modern touch across three key areas: the living room, primary bedroom, and kitchen. The floor plans are set, but finishes, furnishings, lighting, and decorative details are still completely open.  

Scope  
• Develop a unified modern concept that ties the three rooms together while letting each space retain its own personality.  
• Provide mood boards, colour palette, and material suggestions that can be sourced locally or online.  
• Supply scaled furniture layouts with clear circulation paths; CAD or SketchUp files are welcome.  
• Produce realistic 3-D visuals or renderings so I can see how the rooms will feel before we buy anything.  
• List every specified item (furniture, fixtures, paint, accessories) with links or SKU references and current pricing.  

Acceptance Criteria  
1. Designs must reflect a clean modern aesthetic—think simple lines, balanced textures, and a restrained palette with a few standout accents.  
2. Proposed furniture must fit the provided room dimensions without overcrowding.  
3. All deliverables delivered in editable format plus print-ready PDF.  
4. Revisions: up to two rounds per room to fine-tune details.  

I will share floor plans, photos, and inspiration images once we begin so you can jump straight into concept development and keep the project moving swiftly.

title: Manuscript Digitization to Custom PDF
desc:
I have a 50–100-page handwritten/typed manuscript that I need converted into a clean, error-free PDF. The final file must include custom formatting rather than a simple text dump, specifically:

• A clear, clickable Table of Contents built from the section headings I supply.  
• Consistent fonts, margins, and overall layout that follow my style guide (I will provide examples once we get started).

Accuracy is critical, so please use reliable OCR or meticulous re-typing to capture every word exactly as written. When you return the completed PDF, I will spot-check against the original; any discrepancies will need correction before final sign-off.

If you have experience turning print documents into professionally formatted PDFs—and can demonstrate past work with similar page counts—let’s talk.

title: Native Arabic Speaker for Software Proofreading
desc:
Arabic Proofreader Needed for Liwan Studio
About Liwan Studio

Liwan Studio is an Arabic-first professional design application for creating social media graphics, marketing materials, bilingual designs, and print-ready documents.

Liwan Studio is available on iPad (iPadOS) and macOS.

The application supports Arabic and English typography, RTL text layout, professional design tools, and customizable templates. It also supports multi-channel content creation and high-quality output, including:

Designing and sharing content across multiple social media platforms
PNG/JPEG image export
MP4 video export
PDF export for print-ready documents
We Are Looking For

We are looking for a native Arabic speaker with experience in Arabic proofreading for software products and familiarity with software/UI terminology.

The primary responsibility will be to review and proofread the Arabic localized text used throughout the Liwan Studio application and ensure that it is accurate, natural, consistent, and appropriate for native Arabic users.

Job Responsibilities
Review and proofread all Arabic localized text within the application.
Identify and correct:
Spelling and grammatical errors
Incorrect or unnatural Arabic translations
Punctuation and wording issues
Inconsistent terminology
RTL-related text issues, where applicable
Ensure that Arabic UI terminology is clear, natural, and appropriate for a professional design application.
Review Arabic text in menus, buttons, dialogs, settings, toolbars

title: Minimalist Instagram Motion Graphics
desc:
I already have a tight 20-30-second script for an upcoming Instagram reel and need it brought to life as a clean, minimalist motion-graphics piece built entirely from illustrations. The mood is calm and elegant—no flashy text treatments or busy color palettes—just purposeful movement that complements the narrative.

Here is what I need from you:
• Develop a quick visual concept and storyboard that captures the minimalist look.  
• Illustrate the key assets (vector or raster, whichever best preserves crisp lines).  
• Animate the sequence in a smooth, modern motion-graphics style—Adobe After Effects, Animate, or your preferred tool is fine as long as the final result is pixel-perfect.  
• Deliver the finished video in vertical 1080 × 1920 (MP4 + source file) plus a lightweight 1:1 teaser cut.  
• One revision pass included so we can fine-tune timing or transitions.

If you feel the aesthetic, share a couple of relevant reels you’ve done. Once we align on the storyboard, I’m ready to move fast.

title: Whiteboard Explainer VideoScribe Editing
desc:
I’ve drafted a script for an explainer video and now need a talented VideoScribe editor to polish it and bring the story to life on a whiteboard canvas. The core message is set, but the wording could flow better, so I’ll share the current draft for you to tighten up before animation begins.

Once the script is crisp, you’ll create the full VideoScribe sequence—hand-drawn visuals, smooth transitions, and timing that matches the voice-over. I want the finished piece delivered in HD video format along with the .scribe source file so I can make minor tweaks later if needed.

If you’re confident working end-to-end in VideoScribe and enjoy turning ideas into clear, engaging explainers, let’s get started.
